english.title: Fail to give assistance or information to inspector under the Pharmacy Order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable cause, failed to give **(..SPECIFY NAME..), an inspector exercising functions under the Pharmacy Order 2010, assistance or information that the inspector reasonably required for the performance of those functions, namely **(..SPECIFY ASSISTANCE / INFORMATION REQUIRED..)
